x: McDonald was our sixth man in 28th position and Len Adams 38th and Lou Bush 40th gave good support. With such forward running we easily won the "Colman" Cup for the first club to finish their complete team of 12 men, and Ken England is to be complimented on finishing the course after having a bad time.
A good field was seen in the 2 miles run and Eric Bishop, off 260 yds., was a good winner with Martin Williamson, off 180, second, and Lou Bush, off 300 yds., third.

He had made good use of his mark of 2min. 55secs., but as he is only 17 years of age, his run was very impressive. Lou. Bush ran well, in his usual dogged style, to gain second place, and Steve Charlton came through the field well to finish third.

McDonald, who was 26th, winning the award for first Club man home, and he was closely followed by Lou Bush and Frank Mitchell.
